title: WORMAnchorCheckpoint
description: Immutable WORM chain-head anchor checkpoint record (simulating GCS Object Retention Compliance Mode).

chain_head_seq.description: Highest ledger_seq locked at checkpoint creation

chain_head_hash.description: SHA-256 hash digest of chain head locked into WORM storage

locked_at.description: Timestamp when WORM compliance lock was activated

retention_until.description: Expiration timestamp of WORM retention lock (minimum 7 years)

compliance_mode.description: True indicates non-revocable compliance lock active

lock_signature.description: KMS signature over the anchor checkpoint data
